items.title: Nucor (NUE) Could Be 12% Undervalued Following Guidance And Dividend Update
items.summary: Nucor (NUE) just paired fresh earnings guidance with a long-running dividend habit, as the board approved a regular US$0.56 quarterly payout, marking the steel producer’s 214th consecutive cash dividend. The fresh guidance and dividend news hit just as Nucor shares pulled back sharply, with the 1-day share price return down 6.32% and the 7-day share price return down 4.26%, even though the year-to-date share price return is 46.62% and the 1-year total shareholder return is 88.83%. items.title: Netflix, Nucor, On Holding, Xenon, Accenture, Coinbase, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: The S&P 500 and the Nasdaq Composite rebounded to end Friday’s session slightly higher after spending most of the day in the red.  The Dow Jones Industrial Average ended lower as higher oil prices and bond yields weighed on equities.  Glassmaker  Corning  and optical networking stocks  Coherent  and  Lumentum  rose, while chip manufacturer  Intel  fell 0.2%.
